q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of instant noodles per kg?
title: Instant noodles carbon footprint per kg
short: Weigh the flour, palm or other oil and seasoning per kg, and use supplier figures. Add steaming and frying or air drying fuel, line electricity and the wrappers, then divide plant energy by kg packed. Frying oil and fuel are usually large shares.

ul: Frying oil absorbed, from oil bought minus oil left.
Steaming, then frying or hot air drying, the largest fuel use.

p: Report per kg and per pack with its net weight, and say whether fried or air dried.

example.title: Worked example: noodle plant per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 104,100 / 300,000 = 0.347 kg CO2 per kg
Add flour, oil, seasoning and wrappers for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
